answer_1.quote: Performance on these tasks has benefited from the increased context lengths of newer open-source and closed-source models, as these tasks benefit from incorporating a large amount of input context in order to condition the model to generate particular outputs. For many applications such as in-context learning, document QA, and code generation, over a series of prompts a large portion of the input context is fixed.
answer_1.outputs: answers to questions and code completions

answer_2.quote: For measuring accuracy with PreFixQA, we use F1 Score to calculate the similarity score between the outputs and the ground truth (as is used in LongBench for single-document QA tasks).
